rebuttals.argument: We are pleased to see our continued efforts to expand geo-fenced Order Ahead campaigns, offer a $1 credit for first-time users, and implement a tiered loyalty program for repeat Order Ahead users are yielding positive results. The dynamic staffing adjustments in our 12 shops are also crucial for protecting service consistency, which is central to our brand identity. The ruling accurately reflects our strategy and the observed shift in customer preferences towards Dutch Bros for reliable and valuable mobile ordering. This aligns with our goal of turning frustrated morning demand into durable repeat visits.
